Policies

VoterSlip Generator is a Windows and Android app by Aigentools that turns a voter-roll PDF or an Excel list you already have into printable voter slips. All PDF and Excel processing happens offline on your own device; nothing from your files is sent to our servers.

Following the rules of the Election Commission of India and your State Election Commission for every slip you print and distribute is your responsibility. Please read the key terms at the top of the Terms & Conditions.
